summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the new landing navigators on https://speedup-check.preview.emergentagent.com (Next.js). Covered: desktop section dot-rail (1440x900), mobile chip bar (390x844), tabbed 'More about Dynopay' block, hero Explore jump links, anchors/header hash links, page length measurement, dark mode, ES i18n and Reveal/logo regression. Result: all requested behaviours work; ZERO console errors / zero React hydration warnings across desktop + mobile + dark + ES sessions. Two non-blocking findings: (a) page is still ~16.5k px tall on desktop / ~20.6k px on mobile, i.e. NOT measurably shorter than the previously reported 14-16k range; (b) rail/chip bar turn visible before any section becomes active, so for a window of scroll there is no aria-current at all.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigators become visible at pastHero (scrollY > 0.7*innerHeight) but the scroll-spy only marks a section active once its top crosses 40% of the viewport. Between those thresholds (~scrollY 630-1900 on desktop, ~600-1300 on mobile) the rail/chip bar is shown with NO dot/chip having aria-current='location' (verified: rail visible=true at scrollY=1000 with 0 active dots; chip bar visible=true at scrollY=900 with active=null). Suggest falling back to the first section (or the last passed anchor) when active is null.

Jumping to how-it-works (rail dot and hero-jump link) settles with the section top at 68px instead of the intended 96px (other 8 sections land exactly at 96px). Within the ±40px tolerance but inconsistent — the how-it-works id sits on the section element itself (HowItWorksV3) and not on an anchor Box with scrollMarginTop 88px.

issues: document.body.scrollHeight = 16569px at 1440 width and 20610px at 390 width. The 5 folded sections are confirmed removed as standalone blocks, yet the total height is at/above the previously reported 14-16k desktop length, so the 'noticeably shorter page' objective is not demonstrable by measurement. Recommend auditing remaining tall bands (hero has ~700px of empty space below the fold, ProductShowcase, BrandSpotlight, NumbersTrustBand) if the shortening goal must be met.

action_items: Decide/fix the null-active window: give the rail/chip bar a default active section while the navigators are visible but no section has crossed the 40% probe.
Verify the page-length goal — desktop scrollHeight is still 16569px (mobile 20610px), not shorter than the pre-refactor 14-16k figure quoted in the request.
Optional: normalise the how-it-works jump offset (68px vs 96px for all other anchors).
critical_code_review_comments: useLandingNav returns active=null until a section top crosses 40% viewport, while visibility uses the 0.7*innerHeight hero threshold — the two thresholds are not aligned, producing a navigator with no highlighted item.
how-it-works anchor id lives on the HowItWorksV3 <section> (no scrollMarginTop: 88px wrapper) unlike the other 8 anchors in Components/Page/Home/index.tsx — hence the 68px landing offset.
MoreAboutV3 keyboard handler focuses e.currentTarget.children[next]; this works today but is fragile if any non-tab node is added inside the tablist — prefer querying [role=tab].
seed_data_creation: None — public landing page only, no login, no checkout/pay flows touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in this iteration (all PASS): rail data-visible false at scrollY=0 -> true after 1000px, 9 dots with correct labels, labels opacity 0 unless active/hovered (hover sets all 9 to opacity 1), active dot pill height 26px + aria-current='location', clicks on rail-dot-developers/faq/coins land section top at exactly 96px and set active state, rail display:none at 390px. Mobile chip bar: data-visible false/opacity 0 at top -> true after 900px, position fixed, 9 chips, active chip dark (near-black bg / white text; inverts to white bg + #0B0B0F text in dark mode), active chip auto-scrolled into view, docks exactly at header bottom (barTop 65 == headerBottom 65 when header visible; barTop 0 when header auto-hidden, header transform translateY(-65px)), tap chip-more -> #more top 96 + chip-more active, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390 == innerWidth). MoreAbout tabs: eyebrow '[ MORE ABOUT DYNOPAY ]', 5 role=tab buttons, default pain selected with [data-testid='pain-solution'] mounted, each tab swaps to ways-to-get-paid / who-pays-fee / refunds-trust / Learn cards, exactly ONE more-about-panel and one <section> mounted at a time, ArrowRight/ArrowLeft move selection AND focus. Hero jump links: 'EXPLORE' + 4 links with hrefs #how-it-works/#compare/#developers/#faq, all smooth-scroll (top 96, how-it-works 68), location.hash stays empty (no jump-cut). Anchors: all 9 ids exist exactly once; folded standalone sections absent (pain-solution only inside the panel); header Products mega-menu /#features scrolls to features (top 100); direct /#faq lands at faq top 88. Regression: [data-reveal] wrappers toggle in/out both directions (52 wrappers, 7 'in' / 45 'out' mid-page), header coin logo img alt='Dynopay' naturalWidth=134. i18n ES: rail labels 'CÓMO FUNCIONA' etc., tabs 'EL PROBLEMA QUE RESOLVEMOS' etc., eyebrow '[ MÁS SOBRE DYNOPAY ]'; language resets to EN on fresh load. Dark mode: rail active pill + label rgb(129,140,248) = #818CF8, chip bar bg rgba(11,11,15,0.78). Note for next agent: dev server never reaches networkidle — wait on selectors; use mouse.wheel (not instant scrollTo) when you need the header auto-hide/re-show behaviour.
rca_of_the_issue: Null-active window RCA: SectionRail/SectionChipBar visibility is driven by pastHero (scrollY > 0.7 * innerHeight) whereas the active id is the last section whose bounding top <= 0.4 * innerHeight. With the tall hero, the first section (how-it-works) only crosses the 40% probe well after pastHero flips true, so the navigators render with zero aria-current for roughly 1.2k px of scroll. Fix: clamp active to LANDING_SECTIONS[0].id when active === null && pastHero.
